mong_đợi_thất_bại

Translation status: Tiếng Việt reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the vi pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Marks a test as expected to fail.

Aliases: expect failure

Syntax: kiểm_thử <name> mong_đợi_thất_bại <block>

Category#

testing

Related#

  • kiểm_thử
  • mong_manh
  • việc_cần_làm

Examples#

radix/corpus/erratur/erratur.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Marks a test as expected to fail.

# =============================================================================
# mong_đợi_thất_bại — Marks a test as expected to fail
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Expected failure — `mong_đợi_thất_bại` records a test whose failing assertion is a known defect, with no argument.
#   • Modifier position — it sits between the test name and the body, like `bỏ_qua` and `mong_manh`.
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Confusing mong_đợi_thất_bại (expected failure) with bỏ_qua (skipped) — an mong_đợi_thất_bại test still runs.
#
# See also: kiểm_thử, mong_manh, bỏ_qua
# =============================================================================

# mong_đợi_thất_bại — expected-failure test modifier
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   testModifier :← 'mong_đợi_thất_bại'
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   mong_đợi_thất_bại declared

test "known defect" expect_failure {
    assert 1 + 1 ≡ 3
}

main {
    print "erratur declared"
}

Expected output:

erratur declared
